description.text: Please contact us before application to confirm whether this English-medium program would be open this year.

duration.text: The City Planing Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.HSK Certificate Level 4 or above

requirements.text: Applicants for Doctoral degree must have obtained Master’s Degree and be under the age of 40.be healthy
